name: cap-cut
title: 编辑和导出短视频
description: Get edited video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), say something like "trim the clip, add captions, and sync background music", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for TikTok creators who move fast and want quick edits without learning complex software.
title_en: Cap Cut — Edit and Export Short Videos
